1 #===============================================================================
    2 # Data box for regular battles
    3 #===============================================================================
    4 class Battle::Scene::PokemonDataBox < Sprite
    5   attr_reader   :battler
    6   attr_accessor :selected
    7 
    8   # Time in seconds to fully fill the Exp bar (from empty).
    9   EXP_BAR_FILL_TIME = 1.75
   10   # Time in seconds for this data box to flash when the Exp fully fills.
   11   EXP_FULL_FLASH_DURATION = 0.2
   12   # Maximum time in seconds to make a change to the HP bar.
   13   HP_BAR_CHANGE_TIME = 1.0
   14   # Time (in seconds) for one complete sprite bob cycle (up and down) while
   15   # choosing a command for this battler or when this battler is being chosen as
   16   # a target. Set to nil to prevent bobbing.
   17   BOBBING_DURATION = 0.6
   18   # Height in pixels of a status icon
   19   STATUS_ICON_HEIGHT = 16
   20   # Text colors
   21   NAME_BASE_COLOR         = Color.new(72, 72, 72)
   22   NAME_SHADOW_COLOR       = Color.new(184, 184, 184)
   23   MALE_BASE_COLOR         = Color.new(48, 96, 216)
   24   MALE_SHADOW_COLOR       = NAME_SHADOW_COLOR
   25   FEMALE_BASE_COLOR       = Color.new(248, 88, 40)
   26   FEMALE_SHADOW_COLOR     = NAME_SHADOW_COLOR
   27 
   28   def initialize(battler, sideSize, viewport = nil)
   29     super(viewport)
   30     @battler         = battler
   31     @sprites         = {}
   32     @spriteX         = 0
   33     @spriteY         = 0
   34     @spriteBaseX     = 0
   35     @selected        = 0
   36     @show_hp_numbers = false
   37     @show_exp_bar    = false
   38     initializeDataBoxGraphic(sideSize)
   39     initializeOtherGraphics(viewport)
   40     refresh
   41   end
   42 
   43   def initializeDataBoxGraphic(sideSize)
   44     onPlayerSide = @battler.index.even?
   45     # Get the data box graphic and set whether the HP numbers/Exp bar are shown
   46     if sideSize == 1   # One Pokémon on side, use the regular dara box BG
   47       bgFilename = [_INTL("Graphics/UI/Battle/databox_normal"),
   48                     _INTL("Graphics/UI/Battle/databox_normal_foe")][@battler.index % 2]
   49       if onPlayerSide
   50         @show_hp_numbers = true
   51         @show_exp_bar    = true
   52       end
   53     else   # Multiple Pokémon on side, use the thin dara box BG
   54       bgFilename = [_INTL("Graphics/UI/Battle/databox_thin"),
   55                     _INTL("Graphics/UI/Battle/databox_thin_foe")][@battler.index % 2]
   56     end
   57     @databoxBitmap&.dispose
   58     @databoxBitmap = AnimatedBitmap.new(bgFilename)
   59     # Determine the co-ordinates of the data box and the left edge padding width
   60     if onPlayerSide
   61       @spriteX = Graphics.width - 244
   62       @spriteY = Graphics.height - 192
   63       @spriteBaseX = 34
   64     else
   65       @spriteX = -16
   66       @spriteY = 36
   67       @spriteBaseX = 16
   68     end
   69     case sideSize
   70     when 2
   71       @spriteX += [-12,  12,  0,  0][@battler.index]
   72       @spriteY += [-20, -34, 34, 20][@battler.index]
   73     when 3
   74       @spriteX += [-12,  12, -6,  6,  0,  0][@battler.index]
   75       @spriteY += [-42, -46,  4,  0, 50, 46][@battler.index]
   76     end
   77   end
